title: Peculiar Elongated and Sickle-Shaped Red Blood Corpuscles in a Case of Severe Anemia
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The selected reproduction of Herrick’s 1910 paper reports unusual red-cell morphology in an anaemic patient and explicitly states that a definite diagnosis could not be made. It is an excerpt reprinted in 2014, not the full five-page original report.
